meta.title: Luma.Green — Cleaner Tomorrow in Motion
meta.description: Luma.Green connects recyclers, collectors and factories in the same sector: manage inventory, trade recovered material, and settle verified carbon credits in one place.

footer.summary: One ledger for everyone in a recycling sector — from the first kilogram collected to the last credit retired.

recover.title: Recover
recover.summary: Material is collected, weighed and recorded into your organisation's inventory.

trade.title: Trade
trade.summary: Organisations in the same sector list lots, agree terms and settle trades.

retire.title: Retire
retire.summary: A settled trade mints carbon credits that are verified, held, traded and finally retired.

principles.heading: Built to stand up to an audit
principles.intro: A regulator may ask how any credit was produced. The ledger is designed so the answer is always on record.

auditable.title: Every change is on the record
auditable.body: Each state change — stock received, trade settled, credit retired — writes an entry to an audit log that is never edited in place.

exact.title: Numbers that never drift
exact.body: Money is kept in whole paise and mass in whole grams. No rounding error can build up between a weighbridge and a settlement.

frozen.title: Issued credits stay issued
frozen.body: A credit keeps the emission factor used when it was issued. Revising a factor later never rewrites a credit that already exists.

home.title: One ledger for everything your sector recovers
home.lead: Luma.Green connects collectors, aggregators, recyclers, factories and verifiers in the same sector. Track inventory, trade recovered material and settle verified carbon credits — with every step on the record.
home.loopIntro: One circular flow, from the first kilogram collected to the last credit retired.
home.participantsHeading: Everyone in the loop, on one record
home.participantsIntro: Each organisation joins with a role and a sector, and sees only what belongs to its sector.
home.closingTitle: Bring your sector onto the ledger
home.closingBody: We are onboarding a small number of organisations first. Tell us where you sit in the loop.

howItWorks.metaDescription: How material moves through Luma.Green: recovered into inventory, traded within a sector, and turned into verified carbon credits that are held and retired.
howItWorks.title: How Luma.Green works
howItWorks.lead: Every screen in Luma.Green is a view onto one circular flow. Here is what happens at each step, and what the ledger records.

recover.body: Collectors and aggregators record material as it arrives. Stock is never typed in directly — it is the sum of recorded movements, so every kilogram can be traced to where it came from.
recover.point1: Log collections by material and grade
recover.point3: Stock derived from an append-only movement history

trade.body: Organisations list lots to others in their sector, agree terms and settle. Stock is reserved when a trade is accepted, so the same material cannot be promised to two buyers.
trade.point1: Listings visible only within your sector
trade.point2: Stock reserved the moment a trade is accepted
trade.point3: Prices and totals kept in whole paise

retire.body: A settled trade mints carbon credits using the emission factor in force at that moment. Verifiers sign them off; they can then be held, transferred and finally retired.
retire.point3: Transfers and retirements recorded, never overwritten

participants.metaDescription: Luma.Green is built for collectors, aggregators, recyclers, factories and verifiers working in the same recycling sector.
participants.title: Who Luma.Green is for
participants.lead: Everyone who touches recovered material in a sector — from the first pickup to the final audit.

collector.name: Collectors
collector.body: Pick up material at source and record what was collected, where and how much.

aggregator.name: Aggregators
aggregator.body: Sort and bulk up material from many collectors into lots ready to trade.

recycler.name: Recyclers
recycler.body: Buy lots and process them back into feedstock, with the origin of every lot on record.

factory.name: Factories
factory.body: Source recovered feedstock with a verifiable chain of custody behind every purchase.

verifier.name: Verifiers
verifier.body: Audit claims and sign off carbon credits, with the full history of each credit in view.

participants.sectorBody: Every organisation belongs to a sector. You see and trade only within your own, so listings stay relevant and your data stays with the people it concerns.

contact.metaDescription: Get in touch with the Luma.Green team about early access for your organisation.
contact.title: Talk to us
contact.lead: We are onboarding a small number of organisations first. Tell us your sector, your role in the loop and roughly how much material moves through you each month.
contact.securityBody: Found a vulnerability? Please report it privately rather than in public.
